name: WOOL WORG
source:
Marilel has just moved into her uncle's old house, and is about to start her wool ranch life in a new town, a completely different life than what she thought she was going to do!

With her cousin Ilmankor to help guide her, will she leave a quiet happy life in her new town, or is her herd of mysterious monsters going to shake things up?

[From [url=https://cedesdc.itch.io/wool-worg]itch.io[/url]]
